_note: Generation-matched decoy null: the identical de-novo funnel run on CONTROL objectives, to measure how often the whole generate->filter->dock->MM-GBSA->best-of-N procedure manufactures a confirmed-selective, above-null survivor. Screening-null statistic.

control_fp._zero_is_not_a_measured_zero: 0 survivors in 191 pooled generations bounds the manufactured per-molecule rate at <= 0.015707 (one-sided 95%, rule of three) -- it does not establish it is 0.

comparison.verdict: controls manufactured 0 survivors, which is CONSISTENT WITH but UNDERPOWERED TO ESTABLISH that survival is not a generic funnel artifact: the real per-molecule rate (0.005236) sits below the 95% upper bound on the unobserved manufactured rate (0.015707), so a funnel manufacturing at up to that rate is not excluded. More control campaigns, not a different statistic, is what would settle it

_superseded.verdict: real campaign produced a survivor the control objectives NEVER manufactured (0 control survivors) -> survival is not a generic funnel artifact
_superseded.why: the control per-molecule rate was a POINT estimate of exactly 0 from a single 191-molecule campaign, and treating it as a measured 0 made any real survivor infinitely enriched at p=0 by construction. No count changed; only the statistics derived from that zero. The one-sided Fisher p for 1/191 against 0/191 is 0.5.
